# 13(f) securities list fixtures

- `13flist2026q1.txt` — 19 lines of the SEC's 2026Q1 text file, verbatim and in
  file order: share classes and options, `*A*` and `*D*` rows, and the three
  ways the file repeats a CUSIP (an option deleted and re-added, two identical
  lines, two lines that differ in name and status).
- `13flists.html` — the SEC's list page cut down to a few quarters, its links
  verbatim. See the comment at its top for the quirks it keeps.

Both were taken from sec.gov on 2026-10-12.
